title: 第 7 章 伪善嘴脸被我尽收眼底第 8 章 不逞一时之快谋定而后动
lines: 系统的警示音在脑海轻轻响起，陆衍目光不动声色扫向陆家大门外的林荫拐角，果然察觉到几道若有若无的修士气息潜藏在暗处。苏辰早留后手，若是今日讨要丹药碰壁，埋伏在外的几名低层长老就会立刻现身，借着宗门大义强行逼迫陆家无偿捐献资源，用舆论和权势双重施压，把陆家架在风口上，不给资源就是漠视宗门发展、刻意打压寒门奇才。
苏辰脸上依旧挂着温润无害的笑容，丝毫看不出暗中布下圈套，继续柔声开口：“陆师兄，咱们同属青玄宗门下，一荣俱荣一损俱损，我修炼提速，未来也能替陆家在宗门多说话，还望陆师兄成全一二。”跟随而来的两名跟班配合着面露期盼，刻意摆出可怜模样，把寒门修士缺资源的弱势人设演得淋漓尽致，只要陆衍出言拒绝，下一秒暗处长老就会现身发难。
庭院两侧，周伯带着一众陆家下人静静站立，人人憋着一口气，手握炭笔悄悄记下苏辰的每一句话，一字不漏留存证据。所有人都看清对方打着施舍的幌子强取豪夺，偏偏碍于对方身后的舆论和长老靠山，没人敢率先出言顶撞。
陆衍缓步走到庭院石桌旁落座，神色平淡，既没有暴怒呵斥，也没有慌忙答应，慢悠悠开口：“苏师弟想要资源帮扶，情理上说得过去，但凡事讲究先来后到、财物各有归属。”
苏辰眼底闪过一丝欣喜，还以为陆衍打算松口，连忙顺势接话：“陆师兄深明大义，果然顾全宗门大局。”
“别急。”陆衍抬手打断，话锋骤然一转，“陆家祖传先天灵泉被师弟占据多日，灵泉乃是陆家世代赖以修行的根基，单单灵泉每日产出的灵液，换算成淬体丹，最少上千枚，师弟手握我陆家巨额资源，反倒登门讨要丹药，这笔账先算清楚？”
一句话直戳要害，苏脸上的谦和笑容瞬间僵硬，没想到陆衍不按常理出牌，不纠结捐丹与否，反倒直接扯出灵泉归属的核心问题。他仓促收敛失态，迅速切换说辞：“灵泉机缘天降，是我机缘所得，怎能算作陆家财物？机缘落到有才之人手中才不算浪费。”
“机缘落在别人私产地界，强行霸占还能算作天降机缘？”陆衍句句有理有据，“按照宗门律例，私人封地之内产出资源，归属地契持有者，师弟熟读门规，不会不清楚这条规矩吧？”
苏辰被问得哑口无言，一时找不到合适的说辞辩解，只能故作委屈，轻叹一声：“陆师兄这般计较，未免心胸狭隘，我本想着日后修炼有成，酌情补偿陆家，如今反倒被步步逼问。”这套卖惨套路他早已炉火纯青，只要摆出受害者姿态，暗处埋伏的长老随时就能出场帮腔。
藏在门外的几名长老听到院内对话，已经做好随时现身的准备，只等苏辰露出委屈神色便出面施压。
陆衍看穿对方算盘，没有继续紧逼追问，不再纠结丹药和灵的话题，转而闲聊起昨日苏辰在灵谷苛待陆家杂役的小事。苏心头一慌，生怕私下欺压下人的黑料被当众捅破，连忙含糊遮掩，随口糊弄几句便想要转移话题，催促陆家尽快拿出丹药。
围观的陆家下人越听越明白，苏辰表面大度善良，暗地里霸占祖产、欺压雇工，上门白拿资源，一套大义说辞全是用来利己的幌子，之前被全网吹捧的正道天才形象，正在一点点裂开缝隙。
聊了半个时辰，苏辰始终没能从陆衍手里讨要到半点丹药，眼见软磨没用，暗中悄悄打出一道传音讯号，门外等候的三名低层长老整理衣袍，迈步走进陆家院落。几名长老一进场就先帮苏辰说话，开口便是站在宗门角度，劝说陆家顾全大局，拿出资源扶持天才，言语间隐隐带着威压，若是执意吝啬，往后陆家在宗门少不了被穿小鞋。
“几位长老明察，不是陆家不愿帮扶同门，只是资源被人先行抢占，我们自顾尚且吃力，实在无力额外捐献。”陆衍不卑不亢，拿出早年灵泉封地契的复刻卷宗，平铺在石桌上，白纸黑字写明地界归属。
几名长老被地契堵得一时语塞，奈何天道潜移默化影响认知，下意识偏向苏辰，依旧帮着打圆场，绕开地契不谈，只反复强调苏辰身负宗门未来，不能缺修炼资源。苏辰借着长老的帮腔，再度摆出大度模样，假意劝解众人：“诸位不必为难陆师兄，或许陆师兄近期库房紧缺，我再等些时日也无妨。”嘴上体谅，实则再度暗踩陆衍小气抠门，继续给自己刷仁义人设，源源不断的淡金色气运顺着天地落在他身上。
陆衍冷眼旁观全程，默默把长老偏袒、苏辰假意谦让实则步步逼宫的细节全部记在心里，这些都是日后撕破伪善的关键铁证。他全程不怒不躁，既不和长老发生正面冲突，也不松口捐献丹药，用事实慢慢瓦解对方的道德绑架。
纠缠许久，苏辰见实在捞不到好处，再耗下去反而容易被扒出灵泉和苛待下人的黑料，只能带着长老和跟班悻悻告辞。走出陆家大门，方才温和的脸色瞬间沉了下来，转头吩咐手下：“继续散布谣言，就说陆衍顽固吝啬，仇视寒门修士，不肯为宗门出力。”
手下领命，没过多久，新一轮抹黑陆的流言就在青玄宗各处飞速蔓延，不少不明真相的弟子再次被舆论裹挟，跟风嘲讽陆衍品行恶劣。
赵小胖拿着打探来的流言消息急匆匆回到陆家，气得腮帮子鼓鼓：“少爷，这苏辰也太不要脸了，没借到丹药就到处造谣抹黑咱们！要不咱们出去挨个解释，把真相全说清楚？”
陆衍摇了摇头，抬手制止小胖外出辩解的想法：“如今天道扭曲大众认知，越是主动辩解，越会被天道暗中干扰，众人听不进实话，反倒被扣恼羞成怒的帽子，白白给苏辰送气运。”现在的舆论全靠天道加持运转，盲目对线纯属自投罗网，最好的办法是默默收集全部黑料，等合适的大舞台一次性全盘曝光，实现舆论大反转。
随后几日，陆照旧每日出门闲逛行善，一边积攒功德削弱天道厄运，一边暗中搜集苏辰各类虚伪言行的人证物证，灵泉那边依旧紧盯灵气真空规律，静待下一次稳妥的夺泉窗口期。接连几日救助被苏跟班欺压的低阶外门弟子，系统接连弹出良心奖励，身上的天道压制一天天持续走低，修炼速度稳步提升，原本卡在炼气三层的修为，隐隐有冲破瓶颈的迹象。
就在陆稳步积攒底牌之际，系统忽然弹出新的情报提示：苏辰吃瘪之后不甘心，已经暗中开始联络宗门高层，准备借着半个月后的宗门青年小比做文章，打算在比武台上当众出手碾压自己，借着比武胜负大肆宣扬陆衍纨绔无能，进一步坐实陆的恶名，借此收割海量声望气运。
content_en:
The system's warning tone sounded softly in his mind. Lu Yan's gaze calmly swept towards the tree-lined corner outside the Lu family's gate. Sure enough, he noticed a few faint auras of monks lurking in the darkness. Su Chen had prepared a backup plan. If his request for the elixir failed today, several low-level elders who were lurking outside would immediately show up and force the Lu family to donate resources for free based on the sect's righteousness. They would use public opinion and power to put pressure on the Lu family. Not giving resources would be a sign of disregard for the sect's development and deliberately suppressing the poor talents.
Su Chen still had a gentle and harmless smile on his face, showing no signs of a trap being laid secretly, and continued to speak softly: "Senior Brother Lu, we both belong to the Qingxuan Sect. We will both prosper and suffer. I will speed up my cultivation, and I will be able to speak more for the Lu family in the sect in the future. I hope that Senior Brother Lu will be able to fulfill his promise." The two followers who followed him showed their expectations, deliberately pretending to be pitiful, and vividly portraying the weak character of a monk from a poor family who lacks resources. As long as Lu Yan refuses, the elder from the dark place will appear in the next second to attack.
On both sides of the courtyard, Uncle Zhou and a group of Lu family servants stood quietly. Everyone held their breath and secretly wrote down Su Chen's every word with charcoal pens in hand, keeping every word as evidence. Everyone could see clearly that the other party was trying to rob someone under the guise of charity. However, due to the public opinion and elder backing behind the other party, no one dared to take the lead in speaking out.
Lu Yan walked slowly to the stone table in the courtyard and sat down. His expression was calm. He neither yelled angrily nor agreed hastily. He said slowly: "Junior Brother Su wants resources to help, which is reasonable. However, everything must be done on a first-come, first-served basis, and property belongs to everyone."
Su Chen's eyes flashed with joy, thinking that Lu Yan was going to let go, so he quickly answered: "Senior Brother Lu understands the righteousness well and really has the overall interests of the sect in mind."
"Don't worry." Lu Yan raised his hand to interrupt, and the conversation suddenly changed, "The Lu family's ancestral innate spiritual spring has been occupied by the junior brother for many days. The spiritual spring is the foundation of the Lu family's cultivation for generations. The spiritual liquid produced by the spiritual spring alone every day is converted into body tempering pills, which is at least a thousand. The junior brother has the huge resources of my Lu family, but he comes to ask for the pill. Do you want to settle this account first?"
This sentence hit the point directly, and the modest smile on Su's face instantly froze. Unexpectedly, Lu Yan did not follow common sense and did not dwell on whether to donate pills or not. Instead, he directly brought up the core issue of the ownership of the spiritual spring. He hurriedly restrained himself from losing his temper and quickly changed his rhetoric: "Lingquan came to me by chance. I got it by chance. How can it be regarded as the property of the Lu family? It is not a waste if the opportunity falls into the hands of talented people."
"If an opportunity falls on someone else's private property, can it be regarded as an opportunity sent from heaven if it is forcibly occupied?" Lu Yan was well-founded, "According to the sect's regulations, resources produced in a private fiefdom belong to the land deed holder. Junior brother is familiar with the sect rules, so he is not unclear about this rule, right?"
Su Chen was speechless when asked. He couldn't find a suitable excuse for a while, so he could only pretend to be aggrieved and sighed softly: "Senior Brother Lu is so careless, so narrow-minded. I originally thought that I would be successful in my cultivation in the future and compensate the Lu family as appropriate, but now I am being questioned step by step." He has long been proficient in this trick of selling out misery. As long as he poses as a victim, the elders lurking in the dark can appear at any time to help.
Several elders hiding outside the door heard the conversation in the courtyard and were ready to show up at any time. They only waited for Su Chen to show his aggrieved look before stepping forward to put pressure.
Lu Yan saw through the opponent's calculations and did not continue to press the question. He no longer dwelled on the topic of elixirs and spirits, and instead chatted about Su Chen's harsh treatment of the Lu family's servants in Linggu yesterday. Su panicked, fearing that the secret of privately bullying his subordinates would be exposed in public, so he quickly covered it up in a vague way. He mumbled a few words and tried to change the subject, urging the Lu family to come up with the elixir as soon as possible.
The Lu family servants who were watching listened more and more to the understanding that Su Chen was generous and kind on the surface, but secretly occupied the ancestral property, oppressed the employees, and took resources for free. His righteous rhetoric was all a cover for self-interest. The image of a righteous genius that was previously touted by the entire Internet was cracking open little by little.
After chatting for half an hour, Su Chen still couldn't get any pills from Lu Yan. Seeing that it was useless, he secretly sent out a voice signal. The three low-level elders waiting outside the door adjusted their robes and walked into the Lu family courtyard. As soon as the elders entered the scene, they first spoke for Su Chen. They spoke from the perspective of the sect, persuading the Lu family to take the overall situation into consideration and use resources to support the geniuses. There was a hint of coercion in their words. If they insisted on being stingy, the Lu family would inevitably be put in the sect's shoes in the future.
"Several elders have clearly noticed that it's not that the Lu family is unwilling to help their fellow sects, but that the resources have been seized by others. We are struggling to take care of ourselves and can't afford to donate more." Lu Yan was neither humble nor overbearing. He took out a copy of the old Lingquan land deed and laid it out on the stone table. In black and white, he wrote down the boundaries of the land.
Several elders were speechless for a moment because of the land deed. However, the way of heaven subtly affected their cognition, and they subconsciously favored Su Chen. They still helped to smooth things over, bypassing the land deed and only repeatedly emphasized that Su Chen was responsible for the future of the sect and could not lack cultivation resources. With the help of the elders, Su Chen once again put on a magnanimous look and pretended to persuade everyone: "You don't need to embarrass Senior Brother Lu. Maybe Senior Brother Lu is in short supply recently, so it's okay for me to wait a little longer." He said he was considerate, but in fact, he once again secretly trampled on Lu Yan's stinginess and continued to paint himself as a benevolent and righteous person. A steady stream of light golden luck fell on him along the way.
Lu Yan watched the whole process with cold eyes, silently remembering all the details of the elder's favoritism and Su Chen's pretense of humility but actually pushing for the throne step by step. These are the key ironclad evidence to tear apart hypocrisy in the future. He was neither angry nor impatient throughout the whole process. He neither had a head-on conflict with the elder nor relented in donating the elixir. He used facts to slowly break down the other party's moral kidnapping.
After struggling for a long time, Su Chen saw that there was really no benefit to be gained, and if he continued to waste more time, it would be easy to find out the evidence of Lingquan and his mistreatment of his servants, so he could only take the elders and followers and leave in anger. After walking out of the Lu family gate, his gentle expression suddenly darkened, and he turned around and ordered his subordinates: "Continue to spread rumors, saying that Lu Yan is stubborn and stingy, hates monks from poor families, and refuses to contribute to the sect."
His subordinates took the order, and it didn't take long for a new round of rumors to discredit Lu to spread rapidly throughout the Qingxuan Sect. Many disciples who didn't know the truth were once again coerced by public opinion and followed the trend to ridicule Lu Yan for his bad conduct.
Zhao Xiaopang hurried back to the Lu family with the rumors and news he had inquired about. His cheeks were bulging with anger: "Master, this Su Chen is so shameless. He spread rumors everywhere to smear us before borrowing the elixir! How about we go out and explain one by one and tell the whole truth clearly?"
Lu Yan shook his head and raised his hand to stop Xiaopang from going out to defend himself: "Nowadays, Heaven distorts the public's perception. The more you take the initiative to defend, the more Heaven will secretly interfere with you. People will not listen to the truth. Instead, they will be accused of being angry and giving Su Chen luck." Public opinion now relies entirely on the blessing of Heaven. Blind confrontation is purely self-inflicted. The best way is to silently collect all the black materials and wait for the right big stage to expose them all at once to achieve a major reversal of public opinion.
In the following days, Lu still went out to do good deeds every day. While accumulating merit and weakening the bad luck of heaven, he secretly collected personal and material evidence of Su Chen's false words and deeds. Lingquan still kept a close eye on the vacuum rules of spiritual energy, waiting for the next safe window to seize the spring. After rescuing low-level outer disciples who were bullied by Su's followers for several days in a row, conscience rewards popped up one after another in the system. The Heavenly Dao suppression on his body continued to decrease day by day, and his cultivation speed increased steadily. His cultivation, which was originally stuck at the third level of Qi refining, showed signs of breaking through the bottleneck.
Just when Lu Wenwen was accumulating trump cards, a new intelligence message suddenly popped up in the system: Su Chen was unwilling to accept his defeat and had secretly contacted the sect's senior officials, planning to make a fuss about the sect's youth competition in half a month. He planned to crush him in public on the competition stage, use the victory or defeat of the competition to publicize Lu Yan's incompetence, further cement Lu's reputation, and reap a huge amount of fame and luck.
